message: Agent registration completed successfully with automatic polling and token persistence.
Authentication token obtained and validated; implicit in registration flow.
API catalog browsed successfully; 5981+ entries discovered via paginated listing.
Test API located in local registry after initial search failed; agent had to iterate through multiple command variants (jentic search, jentic apis, jentic catalog) before finding correct syntax.
Test API (jentic-test/test-api) found in local registry with authentication requirement (X-API-Key) and endpoint (GET /get) identified.
API reference format inconsistency: agent encountered errors requiring version suffix (vendor/name/version) in some contexts but not others.
Test API operations listed successfully; one operation identified: GET /get.
No direct 'download spec' command available; agent used JSON export workaround to retrieve OpenAPI specification.
OpenAPI spec retrieved and examined; spec shows GET /get operation with no security schemes defined (though X-API-Key required at runtime).
Toolkit access request flow required multiple command attempts; agent encountered errors with invalid action values ('create' vs 'bind'/'grant') and header format (colon vs equals).
Toolkit access request filed and approved by admin; token refreshed to activate binding.
Proxied GET request executed successfully through Jentic broker; received 200 response with expected body and headers.
